title: 第15章 吃了豆腐就想走第16章 权天睿的狠戾
lines: 第15章吃了豆腐就想走？
权天睿小心翼翼的将夏天抱进了座驾，外面倾盆大雨早已将二人的衣裳淋湿了彻底。
就算是夏季，但是柏林的雨夜，还是冷的让人心颤。
权天睿将暖气稍微开了一点，这才让夏天轻颤的身子好转了些许，就连那紧绷的神经，此刻都放松了许多。
随后，司机直接将二人带去了酒店。
全程权天睿都是紧紧地抱着夏天，那模样像是捧着珍贵的瓷器一样，生怕摔了，碰了。
轻轻地将夏天放在浴缸之中，起身，只是没有想到夏天仍旧紧紧地抱着他的脖子，不愿意撒手。
权天睿看着夏天那毫无安全感的模样，心像是被针扎一样的难受。
“乖，我去给放水。”
“真的？”
那小心翼翼的模样，生怕权天睿会突然消失一样。这样的夏天，更是让权天睿自责不已。
“真的。”
唇边扯出一抹让她安心的淡笑，夏天这才慢慢的松开了手。
到了现在她还心有余悸。
权天睿确实没有走，而是直接给浴缸里放温水，有了温水的注入，夏天感觉到整个身子都暖和了许多。
俯下身来，见权天睿手伸了过来。
夏天紧紧地护着自己的衣裳。“你做什么？”
那模样，惹得权天睿无奈了。“你不脱掉衣服怎么洗？”被权天睿这么一说，夏天有些微微的脸红。
这都什么时候了，她居然还有闲情去想那些乱七八糟的。
“那，那你转过身去。”
要她当着他的面儿脱衣服，简直不可能好吗？
瞧着她害羞的模样，权天睿暗自松了口气，看来是回过神来了。
剑眉一挑，看着夏天，丝毫没有要转过身去的自觉。
“你是我老婆，我还不能看了？”
“就算是你老婆，那你也不能这么看着我啊！”人家会害羞的好不好。
当然，这话夏天自然是不会说出来的。
瞧着夏天的那模样，权天睿只是淡笑，但，好在还是转过身去了。
夏天瞧着他没有转过身来的样子，赶紧背过身子，将身上已经被撕碎的衣裳给脱下扔了出去。
完成好了一切，夏天有些松了口气，将整个身子沉入温水之中。
转过脑袋，看到身后的人，哪里有转过去嘛！而是光明正大的看着她。
“你，流氓。”
“流氓？貌似是一个好词语。”索性他就坐实了这个词。
伸手将他自己身上的衣裳直接脱下丢在了一旁，看着光着身子站在自己面前的权天睿，夏天不敢置信的瞪着权天睿。
“你无耻。”他居然直接脱光了，而且这都不是重点，重点是，那身材，真的不论她看过多少次，仍旧觉得惊艳。
此刻的夏天的内心是紊乱的，有些害羞，却又移不开眼。
想看却又害羞的情绪，真的是太折磨人了。
果然，职业会是害死人的，美男纠结症啊！
权天睿自然是察觉到她的视线，唇边的笑意不禁加深了几分，直接大步朝她走来。
瞧着走过来的权天睿，夏天这才意识到不对，连忙伸手想要阻止。
content_en:
Chapter 15: Want to leave after eating tofu?
Quan Tianrui carefully carried Xia Tian into the car. The heavy downpour outside had already soaked their clothes completely.
Even though it's summer, Berlin's rainy nights are still so cold that it makes your heart tremble.
Quan Tianrui turned on the heating a little, which made Xia Tian's trembling body improve a little, and even the tense nerves relaxed a lot at this moment.
Afterwards, the driver took the two people directly to the hotel.
Quan Tianrui hugged Xia Tian tightly throughout the whole process, as if he was holding precious porcelain, for fear of falling or touching it.
He gently put Xia Tian in the bathtub and stood up, but he didn't expect that Xia Tian was still holding his neck tightly and was unwilling to let go.
Quan Tianrui looked at Xia Tian's insecure look, and felt as if he was being pricked by needles.
"Be good, I'll give you some water."
"Really?"
That cautious look, as if he was afraid that Quan Tianrui would disappear suddenly. This kind of summer made Quan Tianrui blame himself even more.
"Really."
A faint smile that reassured her appeared on her lips, and Xia Tian slowly let go of her hand.
Even now she still has lingering fears.
Quan Tianrui did not leave, but directly put warm water in the bathtub. With the injection of warm water, Xia Tian felt that his whole body was much warmer.
Leaning down, he saw Quan Tianrui stretching out his hand.
Xia Tian tightly protected his clothes. "What do you do?"
That look made Quan Tianrui helpless. "How can you wash it if you don't take off your clothes?" Xia Tian blushed slightly when Quan Tianrui said this.
How long has it been, and she actually still has time to think about all that mess.
"Then, then turn around."
It's simply impossible for her to take off her clothes in front of him, okay?
Seeing her shy look, Quan Tianrui breathed a sigh of relief and seemed to have come back to his senses.
He raised his sword eyebrows and looked at Xia Tian without the slightest intention to turn around.
"You are my wife, why can't I watch it?"
"Even if I'm your wife, you can't look at me like that!" People will be shy, okay?
Of course, Xia Tian would not say these words.
Looking at Xia Tian's appearance, Quan Tianrui just smiled lightly, but fortunately he turned around.
Seeing that he didn't turn around, Xia Tian quickly turned his back, took off his torn clothes and threw them out.
After completing everything, Xia Tian breathed a sigh of relief and sank his entire body into the warm water.
Turning my head, I saw the person behind me, but I didn’t turn around! Instead, he looked at her openly.
"You, gangster."
"Rogue? It seems like a good word." He simply took the word seriously.
He reached out and took off his own clothes and threw them aside. Looking at Quan Tianrui standing naked in front of him, Xia Tian stared at Quan Tianrui in disbelief.
"You're shameless." He actually took off his clothes directly, and that wasn't the point. The point was, that figure, no matter how many times she saw it, she still found it stunning.
At this moment, Xia Tian's heart was in chaos, a little shy, but unable to look away.
The feeling of wanting to see it but being shy is really torturous.
Sure enough, career can kill people, beauty boy syndrome!
Quan Tianrui naturally noticed her gaze, and the smile on his lips deepened a little, and he strode directly towards her.
Looking at Quan Tianrui walking over, Xia Tian realized something was wrong and quickly reached out to stop him.
title_en: Chapter 15: Want to leave after eating tofu Chapter 16: Quan Tianrui’s cruelty
